entries.subject: PDS 2001 SN263 component radar shape
entries.finding: The original beta, larger outer component mesh supplies the Shape view: 1,148 vertices and 2,292 faces in kilometres. Weakly constrained facets remain identified in the archive. The primary-aligned pole is an assumption, and the optical no-data grid is not a radar-coverage map.

entries.subject: Native component labels versus catalog/API inconsistencies
entries.finding: Source selection follows native mesh labels and Becker et al. for component identity and January–March 2008 observations. The landing page says 2003; unnamed JPL satellite rows mismatch inner/outer physical values, and rotation-error columns disagree with the paper. Those inconsistent fields are not silently adopted.

entries.subject: Fang 2011 mutual-orbit model
entries.finding: Approximate orbital context extrapolates the 2008 mutual-orbit fit. Current phase and long-term three-body evolution are not measured by this model; rotation remains illustrative.

entries.subject: Resolved optical imagery and mapped composition
entries.finding: The retained Beta source review located no resolved optical image, mapped composition field or present spin-phase solution. The selected radar model remains useful, but this is a bounded recorded search outcome.
entries.revisitWhen: A component-specific observation, registered scientific map or qualified spin solution is located.
